title.purpose: Compact idle verdicts and prominent local state.

label.purpose: Uppercase roles, states, and table headings.

mono.purpose: Code, identifiers, hashes, and numeric evidence only.

shadows.name: instrument-baseline
shadows.purpose: A restrained physical edge on the rule-to-verdict instrument only.

motion.name: ease-signal
motion.purpose: Fast control states and the signal-wire pulse.

motion.name: duration-signal
motion.purpose: One directional pulse after a check run; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Runs the primary check or starts the main connection action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; font: 650 0.9375rem Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--on-cobalt); background: var(--cobalt); border: 1px solid var(--cobalt); border-radius: var(--r-inner); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms var(--ease), border-color 120ms var(--ease), transform 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cobalt-deep); border-color: var(--cobalt-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports reset, refresh, and other reversible secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; font: 650 0.9375rem Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-inner); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms var(--ease), color 120ms var(--ease), transform 120ms var(--ease); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--on-cobalt); background: var(--ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Path Filter
components.description: Switches the result matrix between both paths and either individual path.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; gap: 3px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-inner); } .ds-seg { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 600 0.9375rem Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg:hover { background: var(--cobalt-tint); } .ds-seg[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--on-cobalt); background: var(--ink); } .ds-seg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Result Cell
components.description: Displays a runnable or observed result inside the check matrix.
components.css: .ds-result-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 96px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; font: 700 0.8125rem Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-result-cell:hover { background: var(--cobalt-tint); } .ds-result-cell[data-status='PASS'] { color: var(--cobalt-deep); } .ds-result-cell[data-status='FAIL'] { color: var(--coral); } .ds-result-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--cobalt); border: 2px solid var(--cobalt); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-result-cell[data-status='FAIL'] .ds-result-dot { background: var(--coral); border-color: var(--coral); } .ds-result-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Repository Field
components.description: Chooses an installed repository before loading workflow evidence.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 700 0.8125rem Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); } .ds-field select { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font: 500 1rem Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-inner); } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: Groups repository evidence, setup steps, or case detail without decorative elevation.
components.html:
Repository evidence

Reads SHA-bound Rite reports from installed repositories.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 20px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-outer); font-family: Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.375rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; max-width: 56ch; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rule-to-Verdict Instrument
components.description: The signature diagnostic sequence from mapped paths through the shared gate to a verdict.
components.css: .ds-instrument { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 32px 1.1fr 32px 0.8fr; align-items: stretch; padding: 20px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-outer); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--ink); font-family: Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-path, .ds-gate, .ds-verdict { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 14px; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-inner); } .ds-gate { background: var(--cobalt-tint); border: 2px solid var(--cobalt); } .ds-instrument span { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-instrument code { font: 600 0.8125rem ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', monospace; } .ds-verdict { border: 2px solid var(--cobalt); } .ds-verdict strong { color: var(--cobalt-deep); font-size: 2.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-wire { align-self: center; height: 2px; background: var(--cobalt); } .ds-instrument:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sticky Navigation
components.description: Keeps the three operating sections available without competing with the instrument.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; background: var(--paper); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: Seravek, 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--r-inner); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--cobalt-deep); background: var(--cobalt-tint); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Rite looks like a precise bench instrument translated to the browser: bright, compact, and organized around signals moving from rules through mapped paths to a verdict. Warm paper and restrained graphite keep the interface approachable; cobalt marks active evidence and coral is reserved for failure.

The system favors direct observation over marketing explanation. Humanist sans-serif type carries hierarchy and action, while monospace appears only where code, identifiers, hashes, or measured output require it. It deliberately avoids Overcode's dark, monospaced editorial identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, bright surfaces with crisp graphite boundaries.
Compact rule → path → gate → verdict structures.
Cobalt for action and passing evidence; coral only for failure.
Strong humanist typography with prose kept short.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means action or verified success; coral means failure. Do not create another semantic accent.

rules.name: The Coral Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Never use coral decoratively. Its rarity makes failed observations immediately legible.

rules.name: The Mono Measures Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only for code and data. Navigation, buttons, headings, and prose remain humanist sans.

rules.name: The Bench-Flat Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat and bordered; reserve the baseline shadow for the signature instrument.

dos: Do lead with observed state, the mapped scope, and the next action.
Do use cobalt consistently for interactive state and verified passing evidence.
Do preserve 44px controls, visible keyboard focus, and the vertical mobile instrument flow.
Do keep explanatory text short enough that the instrument remains the visual center.
donts: Don't turn Rite into a dark, monospaced editorial interface.
Don't use coral for decoration, emphasis, or neutral warnings.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, diffuse card shadows, or oversized decorative radii.
Don't use monospace for headings, navigation, buttons, or ordinary prose.
